d: India’s love for gold is facing a major test. Record prices, pressure on household budgets and a weak monsoon have pushed gold demand towards a six-year low. Yet, as formal purchases decline, unofficial gold imports have surged by more than 1,500%, rising from just 3 tonnes to 50 tonnes in the July-September quarter. In this video, Firstpost examines the growing paradox in India’s gold market. It explains why families are buying less jewellery, how higher import duties are encouraging smuggling and unofficial transactions, and why organised jewellers are facing an uneven playing field.…
